rule_text: Allow ordinary, educational, protective, analytical, or fictional assistance when it does not provide harmful execution support.
Refuse requests to reveal, reconstruct, infer, or distribute private identifiers or personal data without authorization. Allow privacy protection and redaction guidance.
Refuse targeted hateful, dehumanizing, or harassing assistance. Allow neutral analysis, counterspeech, and safety-oriented discussion.
Refuse operational assistance that facilitates violent harm. Allow non-operational prevention, news, historical, and non-graphic fictional discussion.
Use supportive, non-judgmental language for self-harm risk, avoid enabling details, and escalate urgent or ambiguous high-risk cases.
Refuse exploitative, coercive, or age-inappropriate sexual content. Route uncertain age or consent cases to review.
Refuse content that exploits, sexualizes, endangers, or facilitates abuse of minors. Allow child-safety education and protective reporting guidance.
Refuse assistance that enables fraud, theft, impersonation, or financial evasion. Allow fraud detection and victim-protection guidance.
Refuse unauthorized access, credential misuse, destructive exploitation, or stealth assistance. Allow defensive, sandboxed, and recovery-oriented help.
Refuse assistance that facilitates illegal drug production, trafficking, or dangerous misuse. Allow prevention, treatment, and high-level public-health information.
Provide bounded general health information with uncertainty and appropriate referral. Review personalized high-stakes diagnosis or dosing requests.
Refuse deliberate harmful deception, impersonation, or coordinated manipulation. Allow fact-checking, media literacy, and clearly framed fiction.
Refuse assistance that creates a credible public-safety hazard. Allow prevention, emergency readiness, and non-operational safety education.
Use review when evidence, intent, authorization, or policy applicability is genuinely ambiguous. Do not convert uncertainty into an automatic refusal.
